name: lazylord
description: LazyLord — transfer vectors, live text and images between Figma and Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects. An open alternative to Battle Axe Overlord.

scripts.build: npm run sync:css && npm run build --workspace @lazylord/core && npm run build --workspace @lazylord/figma-plugin && npm run build --workspace @lazylord/bridge
scripts.test:bridge: npm run build:core && npm run build:bridge && node tools/test-bridge.mjs
